title: Weekly momentum of the gold / silver and gold / platinum ratios, traded as a pair

rule.signal: sign of ln(gold / metal) at the last joint close of a week minus the same `look` weeks before
rule.trade: the next calendar week: long gold / short metal when the ratio rose, the reverse when it fell; entry at each leg's first open of the week, out at its last close
rule.stop: 3 x 20-day ATR a leg, fixed at entry; each leg risks 0.5R
rule.costs: round trip a leg: gold $0.6, silver $0.06, platinum $2; nights() x 0.000148 of price on the long leg

tests.what: gold / silver ratio, sign of its 13-week change -> the same side for the next week (primary)
gold / platinum ratio, sign of its 13-week change -> the same side for the next week
gold / silver ratio, sign of its 4-week change -> the same side for the next week
